findings.statement: An agent cannot prepare the environment non-interactively because no devcontainer, compose file, Dockerfile, setup target/script, or documented install command exists.

remediation.summary: Add a committed setup path (a devcontainer, compose file, or a documented install command in README.md) that runs with no prompts.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know every variable the code needs before running it because 8 referenced key(s) are absent from any committed example file: ADVISORIES, AWS_ROLE_ARN, CACHE_DIR, IMAGE_TAR, INSTANCE_ID, PACKAGES, SECONDS, SSM_DOCUMENT.

remediation.summary: Add the missing keys to .env.example (values redacted) so the environment can be provisioned without reading the source.

findings.statement: An agent cannot discover the codebase through an MCP index because no MCP configuration names codebase-memory-mcp for this repository.

remediation.summary: Register the server in a project config (for example `opencode.json`) or a user config (`~/.config/opencode/opencode.json`).

findings.statement: An agent cannot keep credentials out of the repository and its history because scripts/ci/smoke-test.sh contains 1 credential-shaped line(s).

remediation.summary: Remove the value from the file and its history, load it from the environment, and rotate the credential. The report never records the value itself.

findings.statement: An agent cannot be sure that both files are read because CLAUDE.md shadows AGENTS.md for the harness that defines the pair, so only one of the two is ever loaded.

remediation.summary: Reconcile the two files, or delete the shadowed one — a file nobody reads still gets edited.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know which instruction file is authoritative because 2 vendor-specific instruction files exist alongside the canonical one (CLAUDE.md, CONVENTIONS.md).

remediation.summary: Keep AGENTS.md canonical; reduce each vendor file to a pointer at it, or delete it if the harness reads AGENTS.md natively.

findings.statement: An agent cannot state how many violations exist today because a counting surface exists but no numeric violation budget or count is committed.

remediation.summary: Commit the count or configure a budget (`--max-warnings N`, `max-issues`, or a `violation budget`) so a regression has a baseline number to compare against.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know when coverage drops below an agreed floor because a coverage threshold is described in prose but not configured in the test runner.

remediation.summary: Move the threshold into test-runner configuration (`coverage.fail_under`, `--cov-fail-under`, `coverageThreshold`, or a vitest/jest `thresholds` block).

findings.statement: An agent cannot format a change set the same way every time because a format verb exists but no formatter configuration file is present.

remediation.summary: Commit a formatter config (for example `.prettierrc.json`) so the tool's behaviour does not depend on defaults.

findings.statement: An agent cannot catch lint regressions before they land because a lint verb exists but no linter configuration file is present.

remediation.summary: Commit a linter config (for example `.eslintrc.json` or `[tool.ruff]`) so the rule set does not depend on defaults.

findings.statement: An agent cannot know whether a dependency carries a known vulnerability because a security verb exists but it does not run a dependency-audit check.

remediation.summary: Make the security verb run a dependency audit (npm audit, pip-audit, osv-scanner, cargo audit, govulncheck, snyk).

findings.statement: An agent cannot learn what this project is because README.md exists but is a placeholder — contains the placeholder marker 'placeholder'.

remediation.summary: Replace the stub with a description, a quick-start, and a link to the documentation.

findings.statement: An agent cannot see what changed between two versions because no CHANGELOG (or CHANGES/HISTORY) document exists.

remediation.summary: Add CHANGELOG.md and record notable changes under a version heading.

findings.statement: An agent cannot rely on a consistent commit-message convention because no commitlint config, commit-msg hook, or equivalent exists.

remediation.summary: Add a commitlint config or a commit-msg hook so commit messages follow one convention.

findings.statement: An agent cannot be sure a green CI run means every verb passed because the dependency scan (the security verb) and the docs lint run outside the CI Gate job, the image scan step is continue-on-error, and the required-status-check wiring is not readable from the repository.

evidence.note: gate needs build-test, secrets, codeql, workflow-lint only
scan job is report-only by design (recorded debt)

remediation.summary: Confirm on the platform that CI Gate is the required status check; decide whether the report-only scan and docs lint should join the gate once their baselines are at zero.
